about_short_description.short_description: Telr is a fintech company that provides online payment gateway and digital commerce solutions for businesses.

product.name: Telr Payment Gateway
product.description: An online payment gateway for accepting card and alternative payments across websites, mobile apps, and e-commerce platforms through hosted pages, iframe integrations, APIs, plugins, and mobile SDKs.

product.name: Telr Growth
product.description: A set of payment gateway tools for managing transactions, recurring payments, invoices, multicurrency processing, settlements, split payments, and online business expansion.

product.name: Telr Secure
product.description: An anti-fraud and payment security service that uses real-time monitoring and fraud controls to help protect online transactions and improve payment acceptance.

product.name: Telr Social
product.description: A social-commerce payment service that lets businesses collect payments through payment links, instant messaging, and QR codes used online, in stores, or at delivery points.

product.name: Telr Buy Now Pay Later
product.description: A checkout financing service, provided with Tabby, that lets shoppers pay for purchases in four interest-free monthly installments while merchants receive payment upfront.

product.name: Telr Finance
product.description: A business financing service that provides merchants with access to business loans through an online application process.
